pedidos.pedido: P [238]: 'the applicant will be required to modify his proposal accordingly'; P [239]: 'changes in the design, height, or bulk of proposed structures will be required'; P [246]: 'then the site shall be considered environmentally inappropriate for develop…' (o trecho como a tabela do verificador o guarda; R146–R148). P [241]: 'New roads, grading or excavations will not be allowed to damage or intrude upon the critical viewshed'; P [243]: 'all alterations of natural landforms by earthmoving equipment' (R149, R150). P [226]: siting and design criteria fora da vista (R151). P [276]: 'New structures shall be located where existing topography or trees provide natural screening' (R152) e 'shall not be sited on open hillsides or silhouetted ridges' (R153).
